knowledgeTips.title: Fish Farming
knowledgeTips.desc: Learn best aquaculture techniques, correct medicine usage, and pond management tips.

static.title: How to grow fish faster
static.excerpt: Use high-quality protein feed (28–32%), maintain proper pond aeration, and keep stocking density optimal. Check water pH (7–8) regularly.

static.title: Correct dosage of pond medicines
static.excerpt: Always calculate medicine based on pond volume. For lime (CaO), 20–25 kg/bigha is safe. Overdosing harms fish and beneficial bacteria.

static.title: Keep ponds clean this monsoon
static.excerpt: Remove excess vegetation, check for overflow inlets, and add potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) at 2–3 ppm to prevent bacterial spread during rains.
